dolmen.reason: A dolmen is a megalithic tomb; a dolman is a hussar's jacket. The "-men" -> "-man" plural rule reads one as the plural of the other, which would refuse a legitimate second answer.

germen.reason: A germen is a rudimentary ovary, unrelated to anything German. The "-men" -> "-man" plural rule reads it as a plural of `german`, which would refuse one of the pair; pinned to itself so it keys only onto its own plural `germens`.

limen.reason: A limen is a sensory threshold; a liman is a coastal lagoon. Same "-men" misfire as `dolmen`.

nomen.reason: A Roman clan name, not a plural of `noman`. Same "-men" misfire as `germen`.

somen.reason: Somen are wheat noodles; soman is a nerve agent. Same "-men" misfire as `dolmen`.

theses.reason: The plural of `thesis`, but the decisive "-s" strip lands on the unrelated `these` -- so both frequency and spelling pick the wrong root, and only a review can settle it. Pinned to `thesis`, which is also what src/data/score-overrides.json had to do for the score. Note the two files disagree on purpose: scoring caps `theses` at `these` to deny it a Legend, identity must keep them apart.
